description: This file defines an Android AccessibilityService subclass named ClockBackService designed to provide custom accessibility feedback (spoken, audible, haptic) for the default Clock application on Android devices. It manages event handling, media feedback, and device state changes related to the clock app, including ringer mode and screen state notifications.

classes.name: ClockBackService
classes.description: An AccessibilityService subclass that provides custom feedback for the Android Clock app, handling accessibility events and device state changes to assist users with accessibility needs.

methods.name: onServiceConnected
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up TextToSpeech, Vibrator, and configures feedback based on current ringer mode.

methods.name: onUnbind
methods.description: Shuts down TTS, unregisters receiver, and cleans up resources when the service is unbound.

methods.name: onAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Handles accessibility events and provides feedback depending on current feedback mode.

methods.name: onInterrupt
methods.description: Stops ongoing feedback like speech, earcon, or vibration when the service is interrupted.
